unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
- bul_unify_002: Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value to usage-based forecasting and reusable commercialization patterns.
- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production reliability with audit-grade runtime observability for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates across intake, execution, monitoring, and remediation, enabling more repeatable client deployments.
- bul_unify_005: Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a focused operating model.
